Licensed Specialization

Interior Design Implementation Works (Decor) · Abu Dhabi, UAE

NASAQ brings an implementation-first mindset to interior fit-out, decor, and architectural finishing across the United Arab Emirates.

We are a dedicated team who have worked in the UAE for over 11 years, successfully delivering thousands of projects across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and all seven Emirates. As specialists in decor, interior design implementation, and fit-out, we transform approved drawings and BOQs into physical reality with uncompromising site discipline.

With more than a decade of active presence on UAE project sites, we bridge the gap between design concepts and handover: managing materials, coordinating site works, and executing architectural details to exacting standards.

Our licensed activity in Abu Dhabi is Interior Design Implementation Works (Decor). Our scope covers comprehensive villa fit-out, corporate office interiors, commercial spaces, architectural false ceilings, high-precision gypsum board works, interior drywall partitions, and thoughtful interior renovations.

11+ Years of UAE Site Knowledge

Having operated continuously for 11+ years across the UAE, our team understands local site conditions, material behavior, and programme coordination inside out.

1,000s of Projects Across All 7 Emirates

From private luxury villas in Abu Dhabi to prime commercial workplaces in Dubai and residential developments across the Northern Emirates, our crews have executed thousands of spaces to high standards.

Decor & Fit-Out Specialists

We specialize in the physical execution of interiors: multi-tier gypsum ceilings, concealed lighting troughs, drywall partitions, acoustic zoning, and high-precision Level-5 surface finishing.

Clarity, Care & Communication

From initial drawing and BOQ review to final snagging inspection and handover, we maintain transparent communication and disciplined execution.

Pan-Emirates Footprint

Delivering across all seven Emirates.

Our teams and logistics are fully mobilized to execute interior fit-out and decor projects anywhere in the UAE.

Headquarters and primary operations serving Saadiyat Island, Yas Island, Al Reem Island, Khalifa City, MBZ City, Al Shamkhah, Al Raha, and the wider capital.
